entities.summary: Minangkabau Culture Documentation and Information Center is a museum and research center for Minangkabau culture, located in the city of Padang Panjang, West Sumatra, Indonesia. The center building is in the form of a Minangkabau traditional house, with a large garden that slopes up to the main gate.
